qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the oil pressure switch/oil temperature switch on S14/S50/S38 engines?
What torque value should be used when installing the oil pressure switch on M60/M62/M73 engines?
What is the torque specification for the oil pressure switch on all other engine types not specifically mentioned?
Which engine types require a 27 Nm torque specification for the oil pressure/temperature switch?
What special note is provided for the oil pressure/temperature switch installation?
How does the torque specification differ between S14/S50/S38 engines and M60/M62/M73 engines for the oil pressure switch?
qa_pairs.answer: S14/S50/S38 engines require 20 Nm while M60/M62/M73 engines require 27 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What is the highest torque specification listed for the oil pressure switch installation?
qa_pairs.answer: 35 Nm for all other engine types

qa_pairs.question: Under which section number is this oil pressure, oil temperature, oil level display information found?
What are all three different torque specifications shown for the oil pressure switch across different engine types?
qa_pairs.answer: 20 Nm for S14/S50/S38, 27 Nm for M60/M62/M73, and 35 Nm for all others
